description: Help researchers and staff design, review, and improve surveys and questionnaires. Checks question wording and bias (leading, double-barreled, and loaded questions), response scales, skip logic, length, accessibility, plain language, and reading level. Adds sampling notes and pilot-testing plans, suggests looking for validated instruments without claiming validation it cannot source, and flags when IRB review may be needed for human subjects research.
